whoItsFor: Mac users on macOS 27 with Apple silicon who want to turn off Apple Intelligence, analytics, ads and pop-ups, and Mac admins who need to deploy those settings through an MDM.
useCases: Turn off Apple Intelligence and delete its models to free disk space
Stop Mac analytics, personalized ads and system pop-ups
Deploy the same settings to many Macs with a configuration profile

requirements.os: macOS 27 on Apple silicon (macOS 26 and earlier not supported)
